figures.analysis: 彭博「今日图表」标题：第二季度瑞士央行的美股持仓规模创下纪录新高；来源标注为瑞士央行提交美国SEC的13F报告。面积图自2014年起上行，2021–22见回撤后再度抬升至图示峰值区间。So what：这是官方机构持仓规模的历史读数，不是当日美股beta信号；对大类资产，读的是「全球官方买家对美股敞口仍在扩张」的存量结构，不能单独用来交易今日CPI路径。

themeCards.title: Hormuz reopen still disputed — oil premium holds
themeCards.fact: Inbox: Pakistan says US–Iran nearing an arrangement on Hormuz, but Iran’s supreme-leader advisor (state media) says the Strait stays closed until Tehran’s conditions are met; White House color that Trump sees no need to rush. EIA (desk) sees war-related oil supply disruption lasting into end-2027. Yahoo Brent ~$89; AP Brent +1.4% Tue to $88.91.
themeCards.mechanism: Diplomacy headlines and commercial-flow reality can diverge for weeks — energy inflation risk stays in the bond path even when equities drift into CPI.
themeCards.trigger: Verified sustained commercial Hormuz flow with falling freight/war risk.
themeCards.invalidator: Soft oil drop that pulls inflation-path anxiety lower with soft CPI.

themeCards.title: CPI day meets record CTA bond shorts
themeCards.fact: BLS July CPI at 8:30 a.m. ET today. Inbox: UBS data — CTA shorts on global bonds at a record into the print. Goolsbee: inflation is the biggest problem; labor “stable but not great.” Tuesday: S&P 7,728.20 (−0.32%), 10Y 4.70% (−2 bp). Pre-release at publish.
themeCards.mechanism: Crowded bond shorts amplify a soft CPI squeeze; a hot print re-opens hike odds despite Tuesday’s yield ease.
themeCards.trigger: Hot July CPI that lifts front-end yields and softens equities.
themeCards.invalidator: Soft CPI that squeezes CTA shorts and extends the yield ease.

themeCards.title: USD/JPY near 160 — intervention watch
themeCards.fact: Inbox: yen sliding toward the 160 handle with rising intervention anxiety. Yahoo USD/JPY ~159.4; Japan cash reopened Wednesday (Nikkei +0.83%).
themeCards.mechanism: Round-number FX thresholds raise the option value of official response — cash reopen and FX headlines can diverge.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed official yen support or sustained break back below 155.
themeCards.invalidator: Clean grind through 160 with no official response.

themeCards.title: Tencent results — WorkBuddy / AI metrics in focus
themeCards.fact: Inbox: Tencent reports Wednesday after the HK close; investors watch WorkBuddy (AI office assistant) metrics as a potential catch-up signal. Golden Dragon wiped three prior up-days (JD / TME largest drags).

themeCards.mechanism: Mega-cap China tech print can reset HK/ADR beta independently of US CPI — AI product KPIs matter more than one-quarter revenue alone.

themeCards.invalidator: Clean beat + concrete AI-office metrics that stabilize HK tech.

themeCards.title: Huang caps $500bn AI financing exposure
themeCards.fact: Inbox: after CEO Huang said Nvidia will limit risk exposure on the $500bn AI financing plan, Nvidia credit-risk indicators eased. Related tape: Super Micro and CoreWeave beat/guided hot; both jumped after hours (desk).
themeCards.mechanism: Clarifying Nvidia’s residual/backstop share reduces circular-finance fear — keeps AI-capex demand narrative alive without treating $500bn as NVDA cash outlay.
themeCards.trigger: Filings that show larger-than-signaled Nvidia residual guarantees.
themeCards.invalidator: Confirmed third-party underwriting with limited Nvidia balance-sheet risk.

themeCards.title: China passenger-car exports jump in July
themeCards.fact: 乘联分会: July passenger-car exports 918k units, +87.8% y/y, ~41% of maker sales (vs ~21% a year earlier). Matches inbox “同比跃升近九成 / 41%销往海外”.
themeCards.mechanism: Export share rising while domestic retail soft is a China auto regime split — overseas demand carries makers even when local seasonality bites.
themeCards.trigger: Export growth fade with weaker EV overseas orders.
themeCards.invalidator: Sustained 40%+ export share with stable ASPs.

globalRegime: Pre-CPI consolidation with a disputed Hormuz reopen and USD/JPY near 160: risk assets slipped from records Tuesday while desks still price an energy inflation channel into today’s BLS print.

globalChanged.text: 巴基斯坦表示美伊就霍尔木兹海峡问题接近达成某种安排，但据伊朗官媒报道，最高领袖顾问称海峡将保持关闭状态，直至德黑兰提出的条件得到满足。白宫官员透露，特朗普认为无需仓促达成协议
美国能源信息管理局预计，伊朗战争造成的石油供应受阻将持续到2027年底
彭博经济研究称，美国在对伊战争中使用的关键弹药的储备已低至“危险”程度，补充库存需要耗时数年
瑞银数据显示，商品交易顾问对全球债券的做空押注达到创纪录水平，周三美国将公布的CPI报告若刺激债券价格走高，恐导致此类交易发生巨亏
芝加哥联储行长表示，通胀是美国经济面临的最大问题，劳动力市场稳定，但谈不上好
美国证券交易委员会准备在未来几天推出两项重大举措，其中对代币化股票的创新豁免可能重塑美股市场格局，并为股票代币在区块链上进行全天候交易铺平道路
美国7月份二手房销售降至三个月低点，房价和抵押贷款利率高企持续拖累房地产市场
随着企业加快招聘且通胀压力有所缓解，美国小企业乐观情绪在7月升至近一年来最高水平
日元兑美元跌向160这一重要关口，市场对东京当局干预的忧虑进一步升温
苹果据悉仍将按计划在明年iPhone问世20周年之际推出采用全新玻璃质感设计的iPhone Pro机型
英伟达推出Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，称智能体的任务完成速度有望借此提升30%，据报开源模型Nemotron 4目前正在开发阶段
在CEO黄仁勋表示将限制5000亿美元AI融资计划的风险敞口后，英伟达信用风险指标有所回落
超微电脑本季度营收展望远超分析师预估，人工智能热潮持续推动其服务器需求增长。AI算力供应商CoreWeave季度营收亦超预期。两家公司股价盘后均大涨
RBA left the cash rate unchanged at 4.35% (unanimous, 11 Aug) and may hike further if upside inflation risks materialise.

Record CTA bond shorts raise soft-CPI squeeze risk; do not treat Tuesday’s yield ease as regime change before the print.

chinaStance: Export-led auto strength vs soft Golden Dragon into Tencent’s AI-metrics print; no fresh PBOC primary in this capture (July credit possible later today).

美国批评中国上月在太平洋进行洲际弹道导弹试射前未充分提前通报，中国官员对这一说法予以驳斥

首尔经济日报：SK海力士将恢复在中国大连的NAND闪存生产基地第二座工厂的建设，此举将使当地产能提高约50%
